*March 2019*

Adams sipped his tea as he sat peacefully with his feet up in the control room of the HMS Vengeance. The "inspection" was merely an excuse to get away from HMNB Clyde for a few days, and everyone knew it, but nobody was going to argue with the commander of the base. It was a lot quieter on the submarine than he remembered, almost eerily quiet, at one point he had to stop the captain and ask him if they were actually moving.

He sighed as he fiddled with the radio. He could hear the captain having a discussion outside the door, their communications were down and nobody knew why. Great, he thought, maybe they'd end up spending more time out at sea and he wouldn't have to go back anytime soon. The captain opened the door. "Sir, it seems our commu-" Adams cut him off, "I know captain, I can hear everything everyone says on this sub, any idea when it'll be fixed?".

A few hours went by and Adams was starting to get bored. A young lieutenant walked past and gave a salute before sitting down. "Say lieutenant", Adams asked, "you wouldn't happen to know if that radio is on the blink would you? I was trying to listen to it earlier and had no luck." The lieutenant walked over to the radio and switched it on, and it started working immediately. "Which station were you trying to listen to, sir?". "Radio 4", replied Adams, and a feeling of unease swept over him. One of the checks to determine if the British government was still functional or under threat of nuclear attack was to check if Radio 4 continued broadcasting.

Adams jumped up immediately, sending tea flying across the floor. "Captain! Are our communications working!?"
